---
title: "TAF repositories"
---

Every analysis in TAF is a repository in the [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) organisation on GitHub. This page summarises all of them; [stock assessments](stock-assessments.qmd) looks at the assessments linked to advice.

{{< include ../_generated/status-summary.md >}}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_plot.R")
```

## Repositories by year

Repositories named for a year, `<year>_<name>`, counted by that year.

```{r}
#| echo: false
by_year <- read.csv("../_generated/repos-by-year.csv")

plot_ly(
  by_year,
  x = ~year, y = ~n,
  type = "bar", marker = list(color = blue),
  hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y} repositories<extra></extra>"
) |>
  taf_layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "", dtick = 1),
    yaxis = list(title = "Repositories")
  )
```

## Repositories by type

The type is the last part of the repository name, `<year>_<name>_<type>`, for the same repositories. Stock repositories without a type are counted as assessments.

```{r}
#| echo: false
by_type <- read.csv("../_generated/repos-by-type.csv")
# largest at the top
by_type$type <- factor(by_type$type, rev(by_type$type))

plot_ly(
  by_type,
  x = ~n, y = ~type,
  type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = blue),
  hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x} repositories<extra></extra>"
) |>
  taf_layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Repositories"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", ticksuffix = "  ")
  )
```

## Public repositories

Private repositories are included in the counts above but are not listed.
